Momentus Connect includes interactive API reference documentation in Swagger format, where you can browse endpoints and make real API calls directly from the browser. Documentation for all Momentus APIs is available via the Momentus Connect site.

To access the docs:

1. Navigate to Momentus Connect.
2. In the header, click _APIs_ and select _API Documentation_. The API Documentation site displays.
3. At the top of the left sidebar, select the collection you are working with:
   - Enterprise OData API
   - Enterprise Standard API
   - Elite API

When accessing the API Reference from the Momentus Connect dashboard or Marketplace, the Tenant Details (which determine where API requests are sent) are automatically pre-configured. You do not need to set these manually.

### Access the Docs Without Momentus Connect Access

If you are working with developers or others who may not have access to Connect via your Momentus application, you can send them the appropriate public link, where they can access the documentation directly:

- Americas: [https://connect.gomomentus.com/api-documentation](https://connect.gomomentus.com/api-documentation)
- Canada: [https://connect-ca.gomomentus.com/api-documentation](https://connect-ca.gomomentus.com/api-documentation)
- EMEA: [https://connect-emea.gomomentus.com/api-documentation](https://connect-emea.gomomentus.com/api-documentation)
- APAC: [https://connect-apac.gomomentus.com/api-documentation](https://connect-apac.gomomentus.com/api-documentation)
